name: OpenAI
metaTitle: OpenAI API Integration and Development Services
description: Techlio builds multimodal AI features, voice agents, structured extraction pipelines, and custom assistants on the OpenAI API with strict evaluation and cost controls.
h1: OpenAI models, *engineered into products people use.*
answer: OpenAI provides language, vision and speech models through an API. Techlio builds products and automations on them, from generative features inside a SaaS product to agents that process requests, with evaluation, cost tracking and safeguards around every call.

builds.title: Generative product features
builds.text: Writing, summarising and personalisation features built into web and mobile products.

builds.title: Assistants and agents
builds.text: Agents that use function calling to look things up and act inside your systems.

builds.title: Document and data processing
builds.text: Extraction, classification and summarisation of documents, emails and records at volume.

fits: You are adding a generative feature to an existing product
You need vision, speech or structured output alongside text
You want a widely supported API with many integration options

faqs.question: How do you control OpenAI costs?
faqs.answer: We measure cost per request, cache where possible, and route simpler tasks to smaller models when quality allows.

faqs.question: What happens when OpenAI changes a model?
faqs.answer: Changes are tested against your eval set before release, with a rollback ready.

faqs.question: Can it work with our private data?
faqs.answer: Yes, through retrieval and permissioned tools, so the model sees only what the current user is allowed to see.
